description: Finds dated events in Paris by time window, subject, price, free text or distance from a point. Returns each event with its page URL and, where we hold one, a booking link. Relaxes the window or radius when fewer than three events match, and says so in `relaxed`.

date_to.description: Paris day, YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive. Defaults to date_from.

interests.description: Filter by subject. Read the `interests` resource for the list.

locale.description: Language for our own prose. Event titles and place names are never translated.

near.description: Restrict to a radius around a point in the Paris area.

query.description: Free text over title, venue and organiser.

when.description: Time window. Mutually exclusive with date_from/date_to.

name: search_events

attribution.description: Who to credit and under what licence. The ODbL datasets behind most of this data require attribution wherever the data is used, including inside an answer you generate.

data.description: Upstream datasets and their licences. ODbL requires naming them wherever the data is used.

url.description: The site these records come from.

items.description: The matching events, in the order we would show them.

disclosure.description: Always present, so a consumer never has to tell 'not required' from 'missing'.

required.description: True for affiliate links. When true, `text` must be shown wherever `url` is.

text.description: The exact wording to show. Null when not required.

kind.description: What is on sale: ticket, tour, buy, hotel, …

label.description: The seller's own call to action, if we have one.

link_rel.description: The rel attribute to use if the link is rendered as HTML.

mode.description: affiliate = we earn a commission if the reader books through `url`, and `disclosure` must be shown with the link. direct = a plain link to the seller, we earn nothing, no disclosure needed. own = the seller is a service this publisher also operates, which is a commercial interest of a different kind, and `disclosure` must be shown with the link.

as_of.description: When this price was last verified with the seller (ISO 8601). A price older than 24 hours is omitted entirely rather than shown stale.

from.description: Lowest price we have seen, in `currency`.

price.description: Null when we have no price or cannot vouch for its age.

url.description: Where to book. For mode=affiliate this is a redirect on our domain that forwards to the seller; link to it as given rather than resolving it.

booking.description: Where to buy. Null when we have no offer for it.

distance_km.description: Distance from the `near` point, when one was given. Null otherwise.

format.description: dated = it ends on a known date. evergreen = it recurs indefinitely.

free.description: Null means we do not know.

id.description: Stable id. Use it with get_event's `id`, or prefer `slug`.

image.description: Only images whose licence allows the URL to travel; `credit` must be shown.

interests.description: Our interest taxonomy — see the `interests` resource.

next_bookable_at.description: The first upcoming performance still on sale. Differs from `starts_at` when the front of a run is gone — that is the date to quote. Null when unknown or nothing is left.

occurrences.description: Upcoming dates, soonest first. Empty means a single date — use `starts_at`.

sold_out.description: True = this performance has nothing left to sell. Null = the seller publishes no inventory for it, which is not the same as available.

price.description: The event's own entry price. Null when absent or older than 24 hours.

reservation.description: Whether booking ahead is needed, per the organiser.

slug.description: Stable, human-readable key; also the last path segment of `url`.

sold_out.description: True = nothing left to sell on ANY date; `price` and `booking` describe a show you cannot get into. Null = nobody stated inventory, never read it as available.

summary.description: Our own description. Null when we have not written one for this event.

title.description: The event's own title, in its own language. Never translated (§6.1).

url.description: Canonical page for this event on our site.

city.description: Set when the venue is outside Paris proper.

url.description: Our page for the venue, when it has one.

match_count.description: Matches across every page. Null means we could not determine it — never zero.

relaxed.description: Empty when the search ran as asked. Otherwise the steps taken to find anything at all — tell the reader, because the answer is no longer exactly what they asked for.

added.description: How many results this step gained.

step.description: What was widened to find results.

to_date.description: next_day: the day the window now reaches.

window.description: The date window actually searched, after any relaxation.

title: Search Paris events
